signatures.description: Implement an on-the-fly LTL model checker: translate an LTL formula to a generalized Buchi automaton via a tableau construction, then run nested-DFS emptiness checking to produce a counterexample lasso when the property is violated. It must handle multiple acceptance conditions (fairness), detect genuinely accepting cycles rather than partial SCCs, and emit the exact prefix/cycle split of the lasso. Report 'holds' with the explored state count when no accepting cycle exists.
